Hegotá FOCIL implementation and testing have begun.

### Testing Updates

* CL and EL FOCIL testing has been initiated. CL testing will be mostly consist of reference tests and coordination with STEEL is underway for EL testing.

### Development Updates

* **Besu** has started implementing FOCIL on top of Amsterdam. **[Justin](https://x.com/RoboCopsGoneMad)** has a [draft PR](https://github.com/jflo/besu/pull/120) in early phases, currently at the spec implementation stage.

* **Teku** has merged [Heze fork boilerplate code](https://github.com/Consensys/teku/pull/10398), which includes some FOCIL code such as the InclusionList container. **[Mehdi](https://x.com/mehdi_aouadi_)** plans to implement FOCIL progressively.

* **Lodestar** is giving finishing touches on ePBS devnet-0. Once it is stablized, they plan to rebase FOCIL atop.

### IL Analysis using BlockNative Data

* **[Pelle](https://x.com/PelleKrab)** presented [mock IL analysis](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/17cBgdnVWQ5SC793cLjGMykzPCka8PoD4Kge4crDITxI) based on BlockNative data. The research aimed to answer three questions: (1) how redundant IL transactions are, (2) how 0–2 slot delays affect redundancy, and (3) how different IL building strategies compare.

* With the Top Fee IL building strategy, ILs are roughly full, but about 92% of transactions are already included in the next block, essentially wasting bandwidth. Redundancy increases by about 2 percentage after 1-slot delay and another 0.1 percentage after 2-slot delay.

* With the Censorship-Only strategy, redundancy is about 60%, which increases by 2% and 2.6% after 1-slot and 2-slot delay respectivly. A transaction counts as [censored](https://hackmd.io/@pellekrab/S1YPhS9OWl#23-Censorship-Detection) if it was in the mempool for up to 12 seconds before slot N, was fee-eligible, fit in recent blocks, was not replaced, and still was not included by slot N.

* **[Pelle](https://x.com/PelleKrab)** recommends a hybrid approach combining both strategies and concludes that 0-slot delay is strongly preferred, and 1-slot delay at worst.

Q: Do you have rough data on how long it takes for the 6–8% of non-redundant transactions to get included?
A: About 98% were included within the next 5 blocks, or eventually became invalid. No alarming patterns were found.

Q: Are there common characteristics for transactions that sit in the mempool, e.g. Tornado Cash interactions?
A: It would require further investigation, ideally with archive node access for state validation. Distinguishing actual censorship from historical data is not clean-cut.

### IL Freshness Post-ePBS

* There is an idea to propagate BALs separately from payload and set the BALs deadline much earlier, e.g., 6 seconds into the slot. This would allow IL committee members to update their state earlier and build fresh ILs even when the payload execution is finished late.

- [Teku's Heze boilerplate PR](https://github.com/Consensys/teku/pull/10398)
- [IL Analysis: Bandwidth and Censorship Metrics](https://hackmd.io/@pellekrab/S1YPhS9OWl)
- [IL Analysis — Slides](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/17cBgdnVWQ5SC793cLjGMykzPCka8PoD4Kge4crDITxI)
